rationale: Both prefilter with the even-degree condition and then backtrack. B goes further: it checks the full Eulerian-circuit condition, even degree plus connectivity, in a well-named helper with an explanatory comment. Impossible inputs such as disconnected components are therefore rejected in linear time instead of through potentially exponential backtracking. Its search is compact, with an inner loop over both orientations that avoids duplicating the recurse-and-check block. A has a good docstring and fixes the first domino, which is a sensible pruning. But its degree-only precheck lets disconnected inputs through to a full backtracking search, and its two orientation branches are duplicated code. B is the more robust and better-structured solution.
